title: glyph devin-safe profile: same render, legible glyphs
description: The Devin TUI renders the shade fills ▓▒░ as identical slabs and the waiting glyph ⏸ as a quote mark, so tokens.json gains a per-host profile mechanism: --profile devin-safe swaps fills to a pure-ASCII ramp (. : - = + * # @) and waiting to || while leaving box sets, arrows and emoji alone. This page renders a progress bar, sparkline and key-value rows under both vocabularies and simulates the defects it works around.
